synthesis: Today's focus is XJournal AI and the shift from Model G v4 to v5 — the design document landed this morning and is ready to implement. The v4 RAG audit proved that prompt steering was the only mechanism actually moving output quality; v5 strips away the rule-gating, score tournament, and 6-deep retry cliff, replacing them with a single direct prompt, contextual continuity across the full verse arc, and a hybrid audio input path (MIR metadata → text facts + raw audio bytes → Gemini multimodal "listen"). Before opening the v5 branch, two loose ends from the 2026-06-02 iPad session should be resolved: the generation sliders Phase 2 code is uncommitted and will cause drift, and the iPad editor writing column is still left-aligned at maxWidth: 680. The single most important action today is to commit or stash the uncommitted slider work, then start the v5 coordinator swap — the BPM/Key/Scale metadata editor fields are already mostly built and just need wiring into the new prompt assembly path.
